phase_dependency.sector_transfer: Original physical transpose and cyclic symmetry checked. X-only conditioning transfers to the corresponding Z-only conditioning. Fixed-pair conditioning transfers within the equal-index anchor.
phase_dependency.scope: Certified full-frame upper bounds and phase nogoods, restricted to the stated X-only or fixed-pair condition when present. Local counts are not global frame counts or a number of solved retained anchors. Unexcluded masks are not certified completable.

scope: An anchored UNSAT is one part of a cover reduction under a common wider allowed domain; the separate cover-binding consumer checks that every removed class has such a proof. It uses the parent full-frame cover and a projection preserving the chosen anchor, using signature-independent deletion and hereditary negative consequences conditional on the exact full allowed-pair domain. Domain nogoods are not universal source cuts. No retained anchor is completed and no individual omitted class is excluded from every full frame.
